ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Scenarios
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description: Development candidate for independent starting scenarios. Vanilla base; optional AMJ Grains and Medieval Overhaul integration. Not release-ready. Current unmodified AMJ Core cannot coexist because it still provides the same DefNames. Update Core to the guarded migration version before adding this mod. Existing-save addition, removal and provider replacement remain unverified. RawRice 300 is a draft starting-stock choice.
